title: FeedCourier Plugin Manifest & Meta Schema (Plugin API v1)
description: Strict schema for FeedCourier built-in plugin manifests (plugins/builtin/<id>/manifest.json) and single-file JS plugin `export const meta` declarations (plugins/<channels|processors>/<id>/<version>/plugin.js).

id.description: Globally unique lowercase plugin identifier (2–64 chars, lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, underscores). Must match the plugin directory name.

name.description: Human-readable plugin display name shown in the FeedCourier WebUI and marketplace.

version.description: Semantic Version (SemVer 2.0.0) of this plugin release. For JS plugins, must match the version directory name.

api_version.description: FeedCourier Plugin API version. Must be "1".

kind.description: Plugin kind: builtin (first-party Rust plugin compiled into FeedCourier), channel (single-file JS delivery channel), or processor (single-file JS on_render / on_delivered processor).

runtime.description: Execution runtime: builtin (in-process Rust) or js (embedded sandboxed single-file ES Module). Required as "builtin" in plugins/builtin/*/manifest.json; inferred as "js" for plugin.js modules.

category.description: Marketplace category used for filtering in the WebUI and documentation site.

icon.description: Lucide icon slug rendered on marketplace cards (e.g., "link", "bell", "sparkles", "shield").

description.description: Concise summary of what the plugin does. Either an English string or a localized { en, zh } object.

homepage.description: HTTPS documentation or project homepage URL.

allowed_hosts.description: Normalized lowercase bare hostnames or '*.example.com' patterns that this JS plugin is allowed to contact by default via fc.fetch (no scheme, port, path, credentials, or metadata IPs).

hooks.description: Plugin API v1 lifecycle hooks implemented by this plugin (required non-empty for builtin/processor plugins; empty for channel plugins).

account_schema.description: JSON Schema describing account-level configuration fields for channel plugins.

destination_schema.description: JSON Schema describing destination-level configuration fields for channel plugins.

instance_schema.description: JSON Schema describing provider/instance configuration fields for processor plugins.

route_option_schema.description: JSON Schema describing per-route option controls for processor plugins.

capabilities.description: Optional channel adapter capabilities metadata (e.g. supports_html, max_text_len).
